title: Open Knowledge: Beautiful, AI-native markdown editor and LLM Wiki
description:
Collaborating with AI agents on team documentation usually means copy-pasting markdown back and forth from Notion or Obsidian. OpenKnowledge is an open-source, AI-first alternative that lets you write side-by-side with your agents. it features a lossless bidirectional markdown sync. It connects directly to Claude or Cursor via MCP, giving your models live access to your files. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/inkeep/open-knowledge
